claims: Assess and manage hyperkalemia, with serum potassium up to 6.2 mEq/L, including ECG monitoring and consideration of potassium-lowering therapy.
Monitor blood pressure closely and titrate phenylephrine infusion to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure, given recent MAP 56-68 mmHg.
Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings and monitor respiratory status, including spontaneous breathing trials readiness.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit for anemia, with recent hemoglobin 11.1 g/dL, and transfuse if clinically indicated.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR, PTT, fibrinogen) and platelet count, given coagulopathy with INR up to 1.8 and platelets 131 K/uL.
Assess and manage pain, with reported pain level up to 10, using multimodal analgesia.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin infusion as needed, with glucose levels ranging 87-144 mg/dL.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate, with lactate 2.8 mmol/L and pH 7.33-7.35, to assess oxygenation and acid-base status.
Perform daily sedation interruption and assess neurological status, with Richmond-RAS Scale fluctuating from -5 to +3.
Implement fall precautions and pressure ulcer prevention, given bed rest and Braden scores indicating risk.
